title: Not good with Galaxy Watch 3
body:
The app doesn’t work well with Galaxy Watch 3, while it is supported wearable device for iOS the app itself doesn’t automatically update it’s data from the watch but only when I open the health app, sometimes I have to wake up the watch so to start communicating with the app. If I don’t open the app for a few days then all tracked data from the watch is lost.

The watch itself works great with android version of Samsung Health.

Also Samsung Health doesn’t communicate well with Apple Health app.
author: Nikolay Atanasov
